reference_sql:
SELECT store_code,
       ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_eur) / 1000, 1) AS revenue_k_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY store_code
